content: PHPUnit 13.x is current (Aug 2026) but requires PHP 8.4+. PHPUnit 11.x requires PHP 8.2+ and is the correct choice for this project's PHP 8.2+ floor - do not jump to PHPUnit 13 unless the deployment target is also bumped to PHP 8.4+. SPEC.md's ^10.5 pin is now two majors behind and should move to ^11.0 at minimum for PHP 8.2 support with current bugfixes.
